scope: Five source-review findings and enforced completed sampled review before build promotion. Artist live runtime was not reloaded.

local_full_suite.note: Final full-suite run includes all 26 regression cases. UTF-8 mode avoids pre-existing Windows default-code-page doc-test errors.

baseline_comparison.note: Earlier 22-case subset: includes direct dirty-state reproduction and new contract tests; some failures reflect unsupported new interfaces, not independent runtime reproductions.

limitations: Windows Houdini 20.5.278 disposable fixtures, not a replay of the artist town or every example.
Lifetime test uses a deliberately long-running hython stand-in; separate workflow tests use actual saved-scene verification workers.
Review receipt certifies complete, source-aligned sampled evidence; not artist aesthetic approval or continuous-time proof.
Temporal geometry signature covers topology and supported scalar/tuple attributes, not a universal simulation/intrinsic-state proof.
